ios.desc:
Your private conversations deserve better than "end-to-end encrypted (trust us)." KrypterPQ puts real encryption in your hands: no middlemen, no servers, no fine print.

ENCRYPT ANYTHING
Photos, documents, voice memos, videos: encrypt any file with HPKE (RFC 9180) and send it any way you like. Only the person you choose can open it. Not us. Not Apple. Not anyone else.

ENCRYPTED MESSAGES
Write a message, encrypt it, and paste it into iMessage, WhatsApp, email, Signal, whatever. It stays unreadable wherever it travels, except to your recipient.

KEYS THAT NEVER LEAVE YOUR IPHONE
Every KrypterPQ key is created inside your iPhone's Secure Enclave, the same chip behind Face ID and Apple Pay. The private key can't be exported, copied or read, not even by KrypterPQ.

POST-QUANTUM KEY SHARING
Invite a contact with a link or QR code. Your public key travels back sealed with ML-KEM, the NIST post-quantum standard, so even a future quantum computer recording today's traffic learns nothing. Everyone sees keys only as SHA-256 fingerprints you can compare in person.

CIPHERTEXT THAT SAYS NOTHING
Every encrypted message and file starts with a header that looks like random bytes and is padded inside the encryption. Nobody can tell which algorithm was used, whether a password was added, or how big the original really is.

PROVE WHO SENT IT
Authenticated HPKE lets your recipient verify a message really came from you, not someone pretending to be you. No certificates. No authorities. Pure cryptography.

ADD A PASSWORD
Stack a shared password on top of the encryption, stretched with 5 million PBKDF2 rounds. Even with the right key, nobody reads it without the password.

NOTHING STORED IN THE CLEAR
Contacts, key names, dates, settings and the PIN are all sealed on your device with ML-KEM-1024 under the Secure Enclave, and behind your app PIN when it's on. A copy of the phone's storage reveals nothing.

TRULY PRIVATE
• No account required, ever. Not only not required: there is no way to create one
• No network connections: KrypterPQ works fully offline
• No data leaves your device unless you share it
• No analytics, no tracking, no telemetry
• App PIN with a panic PIN, tied to the Secure Enclave and Face ID
• Decrypted text hidden from screenshots and screen recordings
• Copied text expires from the clipboard after 30 seconds and never syncs to other devices
• Privacy screen when you switch apps
• No ads, no paywalls

BACK UP YOUR CONTACTS
Export your contacts in a password-en

quotes.text:
Hi guys, here's a personal privacy app that I've been doing for a few months now.

The idea is to have a secure offline way of encrypting messages and data on your device using HPKE and a selection of encryption key types, including Secure Enclave bound ones, to protect the data in transit or at rest. As in, encrypt and optionally sign, send by any means, and only have your designated recipient (or yourself) read it. Messages can be shared as deep links for one click decryption with automated quick key probing. Files - same, but via import from anywhere.

No permission requests, no analytics, no accounts, no ads, no subscriptions, absolutely zero online requests. No "make your own crypto" silly things. Everything is using the iOS bundled CryptoKit. Hence the tiny size of it.

Authenticated mode also supports passwords in addition to signatures. Panic PIN wipes all the keys from the app. Software keys can be securely backed up. Full plausible deniability.

For example, a message can be transmitted by any means you prefer. Don't trust a popular messenger or email service? You can use this as an additional sturdy way of protecting it in advance. No metadata, no hidden flags. Just the encapsulated key + ciphertext with no marker of where one ends, and the other one - begins.

The app does not store any info about how you use it, what files or texts you encrypt. You can also encrypt stuff with your own key so you can store it anywhere without having to worry about someone else …
